explication: Dashi PPT is an AI-agent skill for creating browser-editable presentations and exporting HTML, PDF, or editable PPTX. Its user-facing workflow is to describe a presentation, choose among 12 themes, generate a deck, edit text/layout/media in the browser, and export a finished file. The graph includes the documented theme and layout library, plus sampled rendering, contract, and export layers. Some workflow internals are not shown in the excerpts, so documented product links are cited to the README rather than inferred from filenames.
